description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Feature Store Runtime service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method signatures for various operations such as batchGetRecord, deleteRecord, getRecord, and putRecord, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: SageMakerFeatureStoreRuntimeClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon SageMaker Feature Store Runtime service, extending the AWS SDK client.

methods.name: batchGetRecord
methods.description: Retrieves multiple records from the feature store based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: batchGetRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple records from the feature store.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specified record from the feature store.

methods.name: deleteRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a record from the feature store.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific record from the feature store.

methods.name: putRecord
methods.description: Inserts or updates a record in the feature store.

methods.name: putRecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts or updates a record.
